text: The `smil.ref.image.v1` descriptor shall retain required top-level format/profile/digests/entry/segment/initialization/user-fault fields and contain catalogs `types`, `objects`, `functions`, `continuations`, `modules`, and `link`. Provenance shall reside within catalogs rather than silently changing profile digests.
